visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two hosts in white traditional Chinese-style jackets stand in an outdoor urban alleyway. They are smiling and talking animatedly to the camera, using expansive hand gestures to emphasize their points. Red lanterns and traditional shop signs are visible in the background with natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a brightly lit milk tea shop with wooden accents and menu boards. A man in a black hoodie stands behind the counter. One host holds a yellow microphone close to his face while the other laughs nearby. (3) The shop owner is shown in a close-up shot preparing a beverage. He uses a metal spoon to stir a thick, creamy substance in a transparent cup and then places the cup into an automatic sealing machine. The background shows detailed menus and kitchen equipment. (4) The two hosts hold up large plastic cups of milk tea, pointing at the distinct layers of pudding inside. They take sips through large black straws, showing exaggerated facial expressions of delight while nodding their heads vigorously. (5) A series of rapid insert shots highlight different varieties of the drink series, showcasing textures of tea, milk, and custard. The lighting is warm and studio-like, emphasizing the product's appearance on a checkered tabletop. (6) All three individuals stand together in front of the shop. The hosts hold a sign with logos while smiling broadly and making celebratory gestures, concluding the segment in a high-energy group pose.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat pop music featuring synthesized percussion and bright electronic melodies. Two lively Mandarin-speaking voices introduce the segment with high vocal arousal and frequent rising intonations. Cartoonish 'boing' and 'slide' SFX punctuate their comedic movements. (2) A conversation follows between three voices. The hosts' voices are high-pitched and enthusiastic, while the shop owner speaks with a lower pitch and a more relaxed, professional tone. The background music ducks slightly during the dialogue but remains as a steady rhythmic layer. (3) Technical sounds of the milk tea shop are audible, including the metallic clink of a spoon against a cup and the mechanical whir of an automatic sealing machine. The voices continue to narrate the process with high clarity and excitement. (4) Intense slurping sounds occur as the hosts taste the drinks, followed immediately by high-arousal vocal reactions like 'Mmm!' and 'Wow!'. The background music swells in volume with a celebratory, high-energy vibe to match their positive evaluation. (5) The segment concludes with a final melodic jingle and high-pitched cheerful exclamations from all three speakers. A bright 'ding' SFX signals the end of the informative section, transitioning into a high-energy, fast-paced outro with continuous pop music.
